reviews.x: Good size, glass, easy open top, good delivery. Pretty much as described Tops fit good, holes are good size for salt or pepper to come out. Seem to seal tight since salt hasn’t gotten damp yet and I keep these outdoors in Florida. Hope they last. I’ve looked extensively and these are well priced.

reviews.t: Very easy to use and they keep the Florida moisture out!
reviews.x: These shakers are perfect. Moisture is no longer a problem with salt as long as I put it in these shakers. The glass is very thick— my husband accidentally dropped one of the shakers on the tile floor and it did not break—no kidding! And the flip top is very easy to maneuver. I’m very pleased with them.
These are exactly what I wanted! They replaced an old set that had a broken salt lid.  They're prefect for every day and still look good on a fancier table.
These are a little awkward to hold the lid open and pour at the same time; it takes some experimenting!  Otherwise it seems to accomplish what it is designed to do, keep moisture out.

reviews.t: Great price, very convenient, easy to use
reviews.x: Loved that ut had a top on it when I tipped over..

I like them because they don’t spill. I got them for my mom and step dad. They are older so they sit next to them and I wanted them because they end up getting knocked over a lot but they won’t use them because it’s hard for them to use. So kind of a waste. But I’ll keep them Incase the go to the hospital ( which I hope they don’t but just Incase) because they always complain about the hospital not giving them salt & pepper lol

I carry these with me. During COVID, I’m supporting my local restaurants but not eating in. Instead, I’m ordering carry out, and keep these in my car for any added seasoning that might be needed. They are sturdy, and the cap keeps them from spilling.  Highly recommended.
These are great I especially love the flip-up top

These do not keep moisture out.  If you are buying them for that reason look for something different.  I wanted them to use on our screen porch when we do e out there and am super disappointed in them.
Just moved to a warm, humid climate and needed some shakers for the outdoor kitchen...working out great 👍🏻

reviews.t: Keep the moisture out of your spices
reviews.x: I got these for my truffle salt and garlic salt.  You have some spices that can clump up, like garlic powder, that will work well in these shakers.  One thing to note is that the holes are very very tiny.  The parsley in the garlic salt would get stuck.  It’ll work well for spices you want you add sparingly.  Keep this in mind when making your choice.  The lid is spring-hinged so you’ll need to hold it in a way to prevent it from snapping shut as you’re sprinkling.

Definitely moisture proof! The lid likes to snap shut too soon and I wish the top was slightly bigger. You see I'm not a big fan of salting my food, I bought this because I live in high humidity and my salt didn't do well in my old shakers. I use my shaker for scooping teaspoon measurements  but the hole is too small for my teaspoon so I have to resort to using my half tsp. Other than that awesome product.

We got tired of the metal lids on our salt shakers rusting and clogging up from humidity, even when we added rice to the salt to cut down on moisture. These salt and pepper shakers solved the problem. They also have flip-top lids that will keep dust or anything else from getting into the holes or ending up in your food.

We bought these for camping and they were perfect. The contents stay dry as the lid is only open while you're shaking, and then the it snaps shut. I found it simple to use one-handed, while cooking and at the table. Although they aren't fancy, I would even consider them for my kitchen at home.

reviews.t: Perfect for outdoors or  humid environment
reviews.x: I purchased these to replace ones that I grew up with.  After MANY years, the spring broke and was afraid I couldn't find them. I was very happy when I saw them here.  I most definitely would recommend these to anyone who lives near water or uses outdoors.

These salt and pepper shakers seem to work very well and feel very sturdy when using. I am replacing similar ones that have been around for 40 plus years! My husband, who “fumbles” with small items, has no problems with these at all!

reviews.t: I would call them moisture resistant not moisture-proof
reviews.x: This is a good Florida hack.  While I won’t call them completely moisture/humidity proof, they are DEFINITELY better at staying unclogged than 95% of the other shakers on the market.
Bought for my husband, he always complans about the salt not coming out (we live in Florida) because of the moisture. Does a great job of keeping it out.

reviews.t: Can’t unscrew top on pepper shaker
reviews.x: Pepper shaker can’t be opened to fill. Salt is fine. I requested a replacement and agreed to return but have not heard anything yet.

reviews.t: Great for keeping your seasonings sanitary!
reviews.x: Awesome economical answer for s&p shakers you want covered.  Spring action keeps lids tightly closed.
A nice size for the dinner table or kitchen. The lids should help keep salt and pepper moisture free.
They keep the humidity out of the shakers and prevent spills when tipped over.
These seem to be exactly what I needed for home and when I travel.

reviews.t: I live in Florida and the high humidity causes the salt to clump
reviews.x: I sure it will stop my salt from clumping. Just what I needed.

These were bought because here in Central Florida humidity runs high most of the time! I did still have to put several grains of rice in the salt shaker to keep it flowing smoothly. The only issue I have is the fact that the hinged lid does not stay flipped open during use unless you are very firmly pressing down on the handle while shaking. Having arthritis in my hands it's a bit difficult but very well worth it. All in all a good little set of humidity-resistant shakers.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the shakers keep moisture out, especially in humid or outdoor settings.
Reviewers frequently praise the flip-top lid for preventing spills and keeping contents dry.
Several reviewers find the shakers sturdy and well-made, with thick glass that survives drops.
A few reviewers note the lid can be awkward or hard to use, snapping shut too soon or being difficult for older users.
Some reviewers mention the holes are very small, which can clog with coarser spices.
